arc evidence

  • CURIE: gmeow:arcEvidence
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/arcEvidence
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

The creative works or content segments that provide evidence for this arc interpretation. Non-functional: an arc may be evidenced by many segments or works.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CharacterArc -> gmeow:InformationObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:arcEvidence from gmeow:CharacterArc to gmeow:InformationObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:CharacterArc, gmeow:InformationObject
